caseName: The House He Had to Have
title: Lena & Graham

questions.text:
He thinks I sleep through it. I don't.
When I'm home my body won't switch off, and lately his phone lights up the bedroom at one, two in the morning. 😔
He smiles at it, types something, then turns it face down.
Who has been texting Graham after midnight?

Our neighbor. The widow next door who brings us poppy-seed cake.
I honestly don't know if that makes me feel better or worse.
He says he's driving her somewhere early in a few days, before I'm even up.
Where is Graham taking Ilse?

My stomach just dropped. 😳
He was adopted as a baby and always swore he never wanted to know his birth parents. 'My parents are Ron and Carol, end of story.'
What did Graham go to the vital records office to get?

I've seen their ads on every bus shelter in town.
Graham has always been the only one. No brothers, no cousins who look like him. Just Ron and Carol and me.
If he got results, someone out there shares his blood.
How is Graham's closest DNA match related to him?

A brother or a sister. 💔
Eleven years married. He tells me when we're out of coffee filters.
He never said one word about this.
What is the full name of Graham's half sibling?

That's hours from here. So she's not where he's been sneaking off to.
Same mother, two different lives. They must have talked about her.
If his sister knew her at all, she'd have shown him what their mother looked like.
What piece of jewelry was Graham's birth mother wearing back then?
questions.hint: Look through older items in Photos.

questions.text:
Wait.
I've seen one of those before, I'm sure of it, and I can't place where. It's driving me crazy. 😳
Keep going while I think.
In what year did Graham's birth mother give him up?

onboarding.text: I'm Lena. I'm an ER nurse. I stay calm when everyone else falls apart. But for a month my husband's phone has been lighting up after midnight, and I can't stay calm about that.
onboarding.label: Lena

onboarding.text: Graham and I have been married eleven years. Three years ago we bought a little blue house on Alder Lane. He carried me over the threshold and nearly put my head through the doorframe.
onboarding.label: Lena & Graham

onboarding.text: Graham teaches woodshop at Marlow Ridge High. He fixes every fence on our street and never charges a cent. He was adopted as a baby and always said that was all he needed to know.
onboarding.label: Graham

onboarding.text: This morning he went out on the lake before sunrise and left his phone on the counter. I can't bring myself to look. Will you? I'll ask the questions. You find the answers.
onboarding.label: Lena

msgs.text: Graham, it's Ilse. Writing from Tibor's old tablet, forgive the typos.
I have known since the day you moved in.
Two stubborn people on either side of a hedge. Come to dinner and we'll talk.
Walleye were stacked on the east weed line last Saturday. Dad's friend got six.
Dang. I'm in. 5 AM at the dock?
5 sharp. I'll bring the good leeches.
Not the ones from last time that all died in the cooler.
That was ONE time.
Walleye report: 3 keepers yesterday off the point. You missed out
Camp. Next time
My motor won't turn over. Cleaned the plugs, nothing.
Check the kill switch lanyard. I did that dumb thing in April.
...it was the lanyard. I hate you.
Happens to the best of us 😄
Boat motor's making a weird sound. Can you listen to it with me?
Bring it by. Could be the prop
It was a bent prop. $40 and a wrench. You're a genius
Not a genius, just seen it before
Mom wants us all for dinner on Sunday. She's making lumpia.
Lena's on nights but she said she'd sleep it off. We'll be there.
I'll bring the beer, you bring Biscuit. Mom loves that dog more than me.
Lena says you're making her brother's bookshelf? I want credit
Told her it's a coat rack. She exaggerates
I'll take the coat rack. Walnut?
Red oak. Walnut is for people I like 😄
Rude. I'll bring beer
Lake's like glass out there. Thinking dawn again soon.
I'm in. What time are we launching?
Be at the ramp by quarter to five. I'll bring the leeches and coffee.
I'll bring the donuts.
This is why we're friends.
Lake's like glass this morning. You up?
Up. Pulling the truck out now.
Landed a 22 incher. Photo's in the group but you're holding the net like a tennis racket.
Leave it. It's art.
Wind's calm tomorrow. Dock at 5?
I'll bring coffee
Saved you a spot. Fish were biting like crazy
Best morning we've had all summer
Same time next week
Walleye were stacked on the east weed line Saturday. Told you.
You told me nothing, you just caught more.
Same thing. Wednesday?
My motor sputtered twice this morning. You still have that spare spark plug?
In the blue toolbox in my garage, second drawer. Take it.
Got it. You're a legend.
Mom wants fish. Don't forget.
I'm saving the best fillets for her.
Pick you up 4:45 tomorrow? Bringing the good minnows.
Perfect. Coffee's on me.
Out front. Truck's running.
Walked through the Alder Lane place again at lunch. Price is just about right, we can swing it.
I'll pick up extra nights for the down payment. Don't tell Marco, he'll want a cut 😤
We got it. Told you we'd get lucky.
I'm crying in the supply closet. Come get me with a pizza later.
Milk, eggs, coffee filters. Co-op closes at 8.
Got it. Biscuit ate a sock again.
Is he okay or do I need to triage a beagle.
He's fine. Sock is gone, dignity is gone.
Checking's at $212 again?? What is going out?
Mortgage hit early and the truck insurance. I'll go through it tonight.
Do. I'm not mad. I just like knowing.
Union meeting up in Kessling after school. Don't wait on dinner.
Ok. Casserole's in the fridge. I'm on 7p-7a.
Thanks. Don't worry about me.
Quiet one in triage tonight. Texting from the break room. You home?
Home. Long day. Going to bed early.
Heads up, I'm doing Ilse a favor in a week. Early drive, I'll be gone before you're up.
Of course you are. Take her the good blanket from the hall closet.
Will do.
Shift tonight, 7p-7a. Biscuit's fed.
Marco and I are out on the lake early. Love you ❤️
Love you. Wear the orange hat, it'll be dark.
PHEA: Reminder, membership dues are due by the end of the month. Pay online or drop a check in the office mailbox.
Paid online.
Thanks, Graham. Receipt sent to your school email.
PHEA general meeting is tomorrow at 4 PM in the high school library. Agenda: spring calendar, mentor program, bargaining update.
Will be there.
Meeting starts in 50 minutes. Cookies provided by Mrs. Lund.
Thanks to everyone who came. Minutes will be posted in the staff folder.
Reminder: contract survey closes at the end of the week. Takes 5 minutes.
Took the survey.
Scholarship fund raffle tickets are $5. See Danny Okafor or any building rep.
Two books of tickets please. Will pay at school.
Got it. Two books set aside in your mailbox.
PHEA: Reminder that the contract ratification vote is open through the end of the month. Ballots are at the library front desk.
PHEA: Thank you to everyone who came to last night's meeting. Minutes will be emailed this week.
Can someone send the summer meeting schedule? I lost the flyer.
PHEA: Summer meetings are the second Tuesday of each month at 6:30 PM in the high school library. Snacks provided.
Spring picnic at the Lakeside Park pavilion, 11 AM on June 6. Families welcome. Bring a side dish.
Lena's on shift but I'll come. Bringing coleslaw.
PHEA: Union dues for the new year will be deducted starting in September. Questions? Contact your building rep.
Picnic tomorrow. Forecast is partly cloudy and 74.
Thanks for coming! Raffle winner: M. Torvik. The scholarship fund raised $412.
Great turnout.
PHEA: Volunteers needed for the back-to-school supply drive. Sign up sheet is by the copier.
Summer note: the library is closed to PHEA business until school resumes. Questions: email the office.
I can take the Saturday setup shift. Need me to bring a truck?
PHEA: Yes please, Graham. A truck would be great. We'll meet at the high school loading dock at 9 AM.
PHEA: Supply drive collected 212 backpacks! Thank you all.
Nominations for the executive board open July 1. Contact Danny Okafor.
Is the treasurer position open?
Yes, one-year term. Interested?
Not this year. Camp takes all my time.
Understood. Thanks for the quick reply.
PHEA: Health plan open enrollment information session is Thursday evening in the library. Bring your questions.
Is the dental plan changing this year?
PHEA: Premiums are staying flat for dental. Vision has a small increase. Details at the session.
PHEA: July meeting moved to the cafeteria because of floor waxing in the library.
Board nominations close at the end of the month.
Back-to-school supply drive: drop donated supplies at the high school office.
I've got a box of pencils and rulers from the shop. Dropping them off.
Thank you!
PHEA: Newsletter is out. Congrats to our new building reps!
Fall meeting schedule is posted. First meeting is after the school year starts. Watch for the flyer.
PHEA: Annual summer potluck at Pell Lake Park, bring a dish to share. Kids and dogs welcome.
We'll be there. I'll bring Lena's famous pancit if she's not on shift.
New teacher welcome lunch is on the first day of in-service. RSVP to the office.
RSVP'd yes.
Executive board slate: 5 candidates. Ballots go out later this month.
Reminder: ballots will be distributed at school. Don't forget your ID badge.
Pell Harbor Dental: Graham, you're due for a cleaning. Reply C to confirm March 18 at 2:30 PM.
C
Confirmed. See you March 18 at 2:30 PM. Please arrive 10 minutes early.
Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 2:30 PM.
C
Thanks for visiting! Your next cleaning is due in 6 months.
Lena Pike has an appointment on April 22 at 8:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.
This is Graham, Lena's husband. She works nights, can she move to the afternoon?
Yes! We have 3:15 PM on April 22. Should we change it?
Yes please.
Done. Updated to April 22 at 3:15 PM.
Reminder: Lena Pike, tomorrow at 3:15 PM.
Pell Harbor Dental: Hi Graham, it's time for your 6-month cleaning. Reply C to confirm Thursday at 3:30 PM.
C
Pell Harbor Dental: Confirmed! See you Thursday. Please arrive 10 minutes early.
Hi, I chipped a back molar on a walnut shell. Any openings?
Sorry to hear that! Dr. Ames can see you tomorrow at 7:30 AM.
I'll take it.
Reply C if you're on your way. Door is open.
Parking now.
Your treatment plan: a crown. Please call the front desk to schedule the follow-up.
Booked the crown for next month.
Pell Harbor Dental: Thank you for visiting today. Dr. Whitfield recommends a follow-up for the filling on the lower left.
Can I schedule the filling after summer camp ends? It's a busy stretch.
Sure! We have openings in the second week of August. Mornings or afternoons?
Mornings. Before 9 if you have it.
We have 8:15 AM on the 12th. Want it?
Yes, book it.
Pell Harbor Dental: Booked! Your filling appointment is on the 12th at 8:15 AM.
Pell Harbor Dental: Reminder: your cleaning is scheduled for next week at 3:30 PM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Pell Harbor Dental: Confirmed. See you then.
Pell Harbor Dental: Your statement of $64.00 is ready. Pay online or at the front desk.
Reminder: crown appointment tomorrow at 7:30 AM. Eat before you come, numbness lasts a few hours.
C
Paid online. Can you confirm?
Confirmed, thank you!
Thanks for coming in. Avoid chewy foods for 24 hours. Call us if the bite feels high.
Pell Harbor Dental: Thanks for visiting! Please complete our short survey.
Bite feels fine now. Thanks.
Great! Glad to hear it.
Pell Harbor Dental: Your insurance claim has been processed. You owe $0.
Pell Harbor Dental: We noticed Lena is due for a checkup. Would you like to schedule?
I'll tell her. She works nights so mornings are best
Pell Harbor Dental: We have openings at 8:15 AM next month.
Book the earliest one please
Pell Harbor Dental: Booked. We'll send a reminder.
Pell Harbor Dental: Reminder, your filling appointment is on the 12th at 8:15 AM. Reply C to confirm.
Are you awake? Sorry. Can't sleep again.
Awake. Sitting on the back step with the dog.
I can see your porch light from my kitchen. That helps, strangely.
Then I'll leave it on.
Tibor used to say the night is for people with nothing to hide from it. He was wrong. 🙂
Try the radio. Low. Ball game replays help me.
I measured your porch step today. Cedar's the right call, the old one's rotting through.
You don't have to do that. I manage.
I know you do. I'm doing it anyway.
Stubborn. 🙂
Still up? I keep running through what the doctor said.
Yeah. Want me to come sit on your porch?
No, no. It's two in the morning. Lena would have my head.
Lena would say bring a blanket.
She's a good girl. Tell her I said so.
You didn't have to pay for my pills again. I saw the receipt in the bag.
Pay me back in cake.
Poppy seed. Deal. 🙂
I stopped halfway up the steps again this evening. Don't tell anybody.
I'm telling you to sit down every time you do. New step goes in Saturday.
Bossy man.
Thank you for supper tonight. The fish was lovely.
Marco's walleye. I just fried it.
Tell Marco he's a fine fisherman and a terrible singer. I heard him over the hedge.
Will do. Get some sleep.
I'm afraid of closing my eyes sometimes. Isn't that silly at my age.
Not silly. I'm right here, next door. Call if anything feels off.
I know you are. I always know.
Step's done. Go look in the morning.
I looked tonight with a flashlight like a burglar. It's beautiful. Thank you, dear.
Can I come for dinner the night before? There's something I've needed to tell you for a long time.
Of course, dear. I'll make the cake.
You still got that 3/4 flush trim bit? Mine's chipped.
Yeah it's in the second drawer under the router table. Take it.
Bless you. I'll swing by Thursday.
Bring coffee. Shop coffeemaker died.
Did you get the new jointer knives in yet?
Ordered. Should be here by the end of the week
Good, the old ones are chewing up the oak
Deal. Hey, did the district ever send the new dust collector budget?
Not yet. Principal said maybe after the board meets.
Same excuse as last year 🙄
I'm wearing a respirator and praying.
I'm putting you down for the sign-up sheet for the summer camp supply run
Fine. Just not at 7 AM
9 AM at the lumber yard. I'll bring donuts
Now you're talking
Finally got my cherry slab planed. 14 inches wide. Look at that grain.
Jealous. Where'd you get a slab that wide?
Cedar Point had one marked down. Said it had a crack. It's a check, not a crack.
Bowtie keys. Make it a feature.
That's the plan. Table for my daughter.
Dust collector tripped the breaker again
Is it on the same circuit as the planer? Don't run both
That's it. Thanks
Camp starts next week for me, ten teenagers and a lot of pine. Wish me luck.
Count fingers at the end of every day.
Every day. Every kid. Twice.
You still need that cedar for the camp benches? I've got offcuts.
Yes! How much?
Free. Just come get it, it's taking up my driveway.
On my way with the truck.
Pizza party tomorrow for the camp finish. You in charge of drinks?
I've got 40 cans of soda in my truck already
Overachiever
Did you get the band saw blades for the camp or are we sharing?
Got a six-pack at Lakeside. Take what you need.
You're a prince. Beer's on me Friday.
Thanks again for the cedar. Kids loved it.
Anytime. How's the garage project?
Slowly. Insomnia's good for sanding at 2 AM, bad for everything else.
Ha. Come over for a beer Friday... or whatever day. Bring the dog.
Sounds good. I'll text you.
Want to split a load of poplar? Cedar Point has a delivery going to Kessling.
Yeah, put me down for 40 board feet. Venmo you when it lands.
Great camp this year. Kids built some real furniture
The little step stools turned out great. Proud of them
Baseball podcast guy said Twins might trade their closer. Thoughts?
In-service days start the 24th, right? Principal's email was a mess.
Yep, the 24th. Bring your own coffee.
Harbor Vet Clinic: Reminder: Biscuit has an annual wellness exam on the 22nd at 3:30 PM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thanks! Please bring a fresh stool sample if you can. See you then.
Will do. He's been itching his ears more than usual, can Dr. Hale look at that?
Absolutely, we'll add an ear check.
Harbor Vet Clinic: Biscuit's visit summary: weight 27.4 lb, mild ear yeast infection. Drops prescribed, twice daily for 10 days.
Got the drops. He hates them.
Peanut butter helps. Distract him with a lick mat.
Genius. Trying that.
Is it okay if he swims in the lake while on the drops?
Better to keep him out of the water until the course is finished. Wet ears make it worse.
Understood. He'll sulk.
Harbor Vet Clinic: How is Biscuit's ear? Please call if redness or odor persists.
Much better. Clean and no smell.
Wonderful. Free to swim again!
Harbor Vet Clinic: Biscuit is due for his annual vaccines. Reply Y to request an appointment.
Y
We have Thursday at 10:15 AM. Does that work?
That works. Please remind him no treats before the visit, he'll be dramatic.
Ha, noted. Biscuit is a favorite here!
Harbor Vet Clinic: Biscuit's heartworm test was negative. Next dose of preventative is due in 30 days.
Good news. Thanks.
Can I pick up another 6-month supply of his heartworm pills?
Yes, ready tomorrow. $78.
Perfect, I'll be by after work.
Harbor Vet Clinic: Summer tip: never leave pets in a parked vehicle. Even with windows cracked temps can reach 120°F in minutes.
Question. Biscuit ate half a pinecone this morning. Should I worry?
Watch for vomiting, lethargy or not eating. Call if any of those show up.
He's acting normal, begging for breakfast like always.
Good sign. Keep an eye on him for 24 hours.
Update: all fine, pinecone passed. Lena says never again.
Glad to hear it 😄
Do you offer boarding? We may need a few days in the fall.
We do, $35 a night. Book early, fall fills up fast.
Noted. I'll check dates with Lena and call.
Harbor Vet Clinic: Reminder to pick up Biscuit's preventative refill. Open until 5:30 today.
Harbor Vet Clinic: Biscuit is due for his rabies booster next month. Call 651-555-0133 to schedule.
Booking it now. Anything open in the morning?
We have the 19th at 8:30 AM or the 21st at 10 AM.
The 19th at 8:30 works.
Booked. Please keep him fasted after midnight if sedation is needed, though for boosters it isn't.
Okay, regular breakfast then.
He seems to be limping a little on the back right leg after the lake today.
Likely a minor strain. Rest for two days, no jumping on the couch. If it persists, bring him in.
Will do. Thanks for answering so fast.
Anytime. Give him a belly rub from us.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Reminder, staff meeting Monday at 8 AM in the media center.
Got it, thanks.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Mr. Pike, the final grades for Shop II are due by end of day tomorrow.
Submitting tonight. Two students still owe me a project, can I enter incompletes?
Yes, enter I and add a comment. Mrs. Dahl will follow up.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Reminder: staff in-service begins at 8:00 AM in the library the first week back.
Got it. Do I need to bring my laptop?
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Yes please. We'll be updating the grade portal.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Shop room 104 inventory form is due to the office.
I'll drop it off after camp today
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Thank you!
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Summer camp roster has been uploaded. 11 students enrolled so far.
Can you add the two walk-ins from yesterday? Their parents already signed the waiver.
Added. That makes 13. Max for the shop is 14, correct?
Correct. One more and we're full.
Marlow Ridge High School Office: Mr. Pike, fall in-service starts August 17 at 8:00 AM in the auditorium.
Got it. Thank you.
Your room assignment for fall is unchanged: Shop 104.
Great.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: The HVAC crew is working in the shop wing next week. Please cover any tools.
Will do. I'll tarp the table saw and lathe
Your supply order SO-2231 was approved.
Perfect. When does it ship?
Vendor says 2 to 3 weeks.
OK.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Your keys for the shop annex are ready for pickup at the front desk.
Picking them up after camp today.
Parking permit renewals are available in the office from 8 to 3.
I'll swing by later this week.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Reminder to turn in your fall supply order by the end of the month.
Order's in. Mostly sandpaper and push sticks. Some of the push sticks are chewed on by the camp kids. Don't ask.
Picked up my permit.
Thank you.
The shop's fire extinguisher inspection is scheduled for tomorrow morning. Please make sure the room is unlocked.
I'll be there at 8.
Inspection complete. All passed.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Your new class roster is posted in the portal.
Saw it. 28 in the intro class?
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Class size cap is 24 in shop. We'll move 4 students to the afternoon section.
Thanks, that's much safer
Marlow Ridge ISD: Summer camp session 3 ends Friday. Please collect any student projects from Room 112 by 4 PM.
Reminder: class rosters release soon. Check the portal.
Will do.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Reminder to submit your lunch duty preference.
Submitted just now
Marlow Ridge ISD: Reminder - staff in-service begins August 24. Check your email for the schedule.
Marlow Ridge HS Office: Staff in-service starts the week before school. Schedule to follow.
Your supply shipment arrived. Boxes are in the hallway outside Shop 104.
Great. I'll go in this afternoon and stack them.
Thank you, Mr. Pike.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Walleye are on the move! Leeches and crawlers fresh in this week.
What time do you open tomorrow? Want to be on the water by 5
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: We open at 4:30 AM during the season. Cooler's out front if you need to grab and go.
Can you set aside two dozen leeches and a dozen crawlers?
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Done. Leave cash in the envelope under Pike if we're not up.
Thanks. Appreciate it
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Fresh leeches and nightcrawlers in. Open 5 AM daily.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Reminder: your annual fishing license renewal is coming up. We can process it in store.
Will do next time I'm in. Are you still carrying the 1/4 oz jigs in chartreuse?
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Chartreuse and glow both. Pack of 5 is $6.49.
Grab me two packs of each then
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Will do. Anything else?
A new net if you have one with a longer handle. Lost mine off the dock
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Ha, we have one with a 36 inch handle. $22.
Sold
Got any 3/8 oz jigs in chartreuse? Out of them.
Yep, a whole pegboard. Bring $5 and a cooler.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Walleye report. Good bite at dawn on the north side near the points, 14-18 feet.
Thanks for the tip. Heading out Saturday with Marco.
Good luck. Weed line is the spot after sunrise. Water's 71 degrees.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Weekly report: water temp 66, fish holding on the north weed line at 12 to 14 ft. Slip bobber with a leech.
Thanks for the tip. Marco and I will try it at first light
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Good luck! Send a pic if you land a big one.
Does the shop sell ice this early or just in the summer?
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Bagged ice year round. 10 lb bags $2.50.
Two bags please, I'll be there in 10
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: They'll be on the porch.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Our summer kids' fishing clinic is open for sign-ups. Ages 8 to 14, free.
I might send a couple of my camp kids over. How many spots?
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: 20 per session. Plenty open.
Cool, I'll pass it along
Annual fishing license renewal reminder, don't forget! We can do it at the counter.
I'll come in Friday and renew. Do you have the little sleeve for it?
Yep. Waterproof ones, 2 bucks.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Your fishing license is ready to print. Come on by when you can.
Stopping in this afternoon
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Thanks for stopping by! All set through next year.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Weekend sale. 20% off all rods and reels, fall walleye is coming.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Heads up: the east launch has low water. Use the main ramp at the marina.
Good to know. Appreciate the text
Can you hold two dozen leeches for Thursday, 4:30 AM pickup? Do you do early?
We open at 4:30 on weekdays for fishermen. They'll be in a cup with your name.
Perfect. Thank you.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Closed Monday for inventory. Back Tuesday at 5 AM.
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Fresh leeches in. Want us to hold two dozen for the early trip?
Yes please. Marco and I are going out tomorrow before sunrise
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Hold them in the cooler by the door. Tight lines 🎣
Pell Lake Bait & Tackle: Just a reminder, we're closing early at 4 PM tomorrow for inventory.
Thanks. I'll get my stuff before then
Graham, Bill. Dock goes in tomorrow morning if you can lend a hand.
What time?
Eight. Bring waders, the water's still cold.
Will do. Marco might come too.
The more the merrier. I'll have coffee.
Thanks for yesterday. My back says I'm 74, not 64.
Mine too. Ibuprofen and a nap.
Beer's on me when the fish are biting.
Do you still have the 6-inch jointer? My belt snapped on mine.
Yeah, I can lend it. Which belt size? I might have a spare.
Says 3L-280 on the old one.
Checked the drawer. Got one. Come by after supper.
On my way.
Belt fits like a glove. I owe you.
You owe me a walleye fillet.
Ha. Done.
Lake's flat as glass. Anything biting?
Couple of keepers off the point by the old pilings. Using a leech rig.
Leeches. Always the leeches.
Twins on the radio tonight. Listening in the garage?
Already am. Bullpen's gonna give it away.
You called it. Bullpen.
Every time.
Mower's making a noise like a coffee grinder. You know small engines?
Some. Is it the blade or the engine?
Blade I think. Hit a rock.
Probably bent. Don't run it. I'll come look this evening.
Blade's bent. Harbor Hardware has the part, I'll grab one tomorrow.
You're a gentleman.
Blade's on, balanced it. Runs smooth now.
Cold ones in my garage fridge. Help yourself anytime.
Fog this morning thick as soup. Stayed in.
Same. Marco texted that we'd wait for it to lift.
Wise.
Are you going to the fish fry at the marina? Proceeds go to the fire department.
Lena's working. I might swing by for a plate.
Get the walleye, skip the coleslaw.
Noted.
Dock light's flickering. You have any marine wire nuts?
I do. I'll drop some by later today.
You going to the Saturday softball game? We need a catcher.
My knees say no. My heart says yes.
Heart wins. 10 AM at Fields Park.
Didn't tell me we'd lose by 12.
Rematch next month. Bring ice.
Did you see the memo about the new safety goggles?
Yeah. About time, ours are scratched to hell
Twins game next month? I can get 4 tickets from my brother-in-law.
Count me in. Lena's got shifts, I'll ask.
No pressure. Bring Marco if he wants.
Lena can't, she's on nights. Marco and I are in.
Perfect, four seats, three of us. I'll find a fourth.
Want to split a bulk order of maple? Cedar Point has a deal
How much are we talking?
200 board feet. $3.80 a foot if we take it all
I'll take half. Sending you a check at school
Deal
Got the tickets. Section 114. Game's July 11.
Great. I'll drive. Truck fits four.
Not if Marco's in the back with his cooler.
Fair.
That podcast you sent about the '91 World Series. Brilliant.
Right? Kirby Puckett game six. I get chills.
Maple arrived. Stacked in the corner of the shop
Can you give me a hand moving it tomorrow?
Sure. Bring gloves
Lunch tomorrow? My treat for the help
Co-op deli. Reuben
Leaving at noon?
Noon works. Meet at my place.
That was a good one. Extra innings!

Leeches work fine anyway.

notes.title: Board feet cheat sheet
notes.body:
Board feet = thickness (in) x width (in) x length (ft) / 12

1x6x8 = 4 bf
2x4x8 = 5.33 bf
4/4 walnut, 8" wide, 6 ft = 4 bf

Add 15% for waste. Add 25% if the boards have knots.

Cedar Point Hardwoods price sheet is in the truck door pocket. Walnut was $11.50/bf last time, check again.
